title: Fourier Batch Size Bound
statement: Let $n,k,b$ be natural numbers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\delta$ be rational with $0<\delta\le 1/2$. Write $d=n-|P|$, $r=\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$, and let $\mathcal F$ be the family of subsets of a $d$-element set having size at most $r$. Put $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, $c=\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil\rceil$, $L=c+2(r+1)+5$, and $A=(r+1)(36\cdot4^kL)$. Define $\alpha=1/(3\cdot2^k)$, $\eta=\delta/(4|\mathcal F|T_k)$, and let $S=\left\lceil 2\,\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\eta\rceil\rceil/\alpha^2\right\rceil$. Then $|\mathcal F|S\le A(n+1)^{r+1}(b+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of an $n$-element index set
